en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a highly ornate triumphal arch standing alone in a snowy landscape. The wooden arch has two tall towers with spires, rich decorative details, and the imperial Russian double-headed eagle crest on top. Below the image there is Russian pre‑revolutionary text identifying the location as Khabarovsk and explaining that the arch commemorates a journey of Emperor Nicholas II when he was still heir to the throne.
